_howTo: reference.items: one per (clip, metric) measured by an INDEPENDENT reference method (e.g. calibrated goniometer / photogrammetry on a marker set). Say which in provenance.referenceMethod.
referenceIndependentOfSystem must be true only if the reference does not use the pose model.
Run: npm run validate -- pose --reference ref.json --results results.json [--tolerances '{"static.shoulder_line_tilt":2}'] --out report.json
